blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo challenged the need for Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense witness to continue explaining bank confidentiality on Thursday, Nov. 19, citing the Bank Secrecy Law’s exception for impeachment cases. “You’re not needed here, if you think about it,” Tulfo told lawyer and certified public accountant Rainer Dela Fuente, a former Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) financial investigator now working as a private anti-money laundering consultant. The exchange came during defense counsel Mark Vinluan’s direct examination of Dela Fuente on summaries of covered and suspicious transaction reports and the rules governing their disclosure.
